brief.headline: Advent seeks up to $500m in renewed Learning Lab sale
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Advent International is seeking to sell Singapore-based education provider The Learning Lab for between $400m and $500m, marking its second attempt to exit the business since 2021, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Infrastructure & Energy: SpaceX announced it plans spend $74B on data center campuses in Texas and Arizona, a significant expansion of the Elon Musk-owned firm's footprint.

Infrastructure & Energy: Blackstone-backed Rowan Digital Infrastructure has secured approximately $1.5bn in additional financing to support the development of its US data centre portfolio, as investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure continues to drive demand for capacity, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Investor Outlook: Nvidia's post-Jensen Huang era has just begun and there are so many open questions about the company's future.

Fed & Rates: Federal Reserve official Jefferson spoke on “New Technology, Old Questions: Productivity Puzzles and the Macroeconomy” at the University of California, San Diego Economic Roundtable, San Diego, California.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,561.67 (down 0.4% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 18.7, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.10% (up 12 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.27 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.20%, near long-run norms (down 10 bps on the prior reading).

items.title: Ares raises $3.6bn for major private credit continuation fund
